hard_checks.criterion: Main boots with real motorcycle scene, fork/wheel/lean script and motorcycle engine sound.
Actual Tab event while physical speed<0.5m/s and drive state<.08 swaps to other scene with same sphere position/model heading; camera target valid; only1 Vehicle/Sphere active.
Tab at speed>=.5m/s or active drive rejected with visible stop-first text; no vehicle replacement.
Repeated alternating switches leave one active vehicle; both vehicles move with actual forward input; motorcycle effects exercised.
Original track GridMap, static models, license/assets/input mappings retained.

human_checks: Human compares motorcycle handling/lean and camera continuity after switching; HUD readability.
limits: Developer implementation and scripted verification; root separately reviews. Test setup injection is labeled, never claimed human play.
